$description: The color vocabulary of this skill as data: what each concept means, what it is for, what it is not, and which names it owns. One term, one meaning; `aliases` are accepted spellings, `avoid` are words not to use for it. `roles` lists every role variable the color system emits and the concept it belongs to. check.mjs validates this file: the role catalogue against what the runs emit (both ways), every concept's term or alias used in SKILL.md or references/system.md, no `avoid` phrase in the docs, and every concrete `names` variable emitted.

principles.why: A color the browser derives (color-mix, calc, relative color) is not in the system's files, so no tool can check, export or audit it.
principles.detail: A variable is a color (oklch, with alpha when translucent) or an alias naming another variable. Never color-mix(), calc() or `from` syntax.

principles.why: Shared words (surface, secondary, theme) let two people agree on a name and disagree on the color.

principles.rule: A role names a step; it does not invent a color.
principles.why: Every role is then explained by its family, step and mode. The only exceptions are translucent roles (a step at a fixed alpha) and an in-between selection emphasis (a generated OKLCH mix).

concepts.definition: One seed color turned into Base 050–950 and the Primes by scripts/generate.cjs, with the seed kept exact as its tagged source.
concepts.intent: A swatch library for brand, marketing and illustration work, or the input to a color system.
concepts.not: Not a UI color system: no modes, roles or contrast placement.

concepts.definition: A tone of a source palette, 050 lightest to 950 darkest, on the HCT tone ladder.
concepts.intent: A fixed, mode-independent lightness ladder for one seed.
concepts.not: Not a step: a base stop has no job and no mode. Shares its numbering with the tonal stop but belongs to a different output.

concepts.definition: A source palette's named brightness set (brightest … dimmest) around the seed.
concepts.intent: Picking a seed variant by name rather than by number.

concepts.definition: A named set of seed colors in scripts/presets.json, each run as a source palette (scripts/preset.mjs).
concepts.intent: A fixed brand set that isn't an evenly spaced hue spectrum.
concepts.not: Not a request preset (system.mjs `preset`), which fills request defaults.

concepts.definition: One neutral or lightly tinted source ramp that generate.cjs adds beside the core palettes (the `material` option), named after Material Design's neutral palettes.
concepts.intent: A neutral to pair with a source palette set.
concepts.not: Not a Material Design semantic theme, and not a ui-materials material (Flat, Physical, Frosted, Glass, Outline), which is how a part is painted.

concepts.definition: The output of scripts/system.mjs: families × modes × steps, plus roles, alpha steps, the tonal layer and reports.
concepts.intent: Everything a UI paints with, in every mode, contrast-placed and checked.

concepts.definition: One ramp of twelve steps per mode: an accent hue or a neutral.
concepts.intent: The unit roles point at.

concepts.definition: Any non-neutral family (the twelve hues by default).
concepts.intent: Naming the hue families as a group, apart from the neutrals.
concepts.not: Not a role. Primary and secondary are roles that point at accents. ui-materials calls the primary role's solid 'the primary solid' and reads it through an input named --accent; that input is one role's color, not this group of families.

concepts.definition: The low-chroma family that paints pages, surfaces, borders and text. Its CSS family name is gray; with `neutrals` it splits into ground, surface and ink, and gray becomes an alias of ink.
concepts.intent: One tinted grey that carries most of the interface.

concepts.definition: The neutral family of the page: bg, bg-subtle and what is cast onto the page (shadow).
concepts.intent: The color everything sits on.
concepts.not: Not cards or panels (that is surface). As an anchor role, `ground` pins this family's step 1 in light. ui-materials uses `ground` for a relief value (the part others sit on), a public name there; in this skill ground is only the page's neutral family.

concepts.definition: The neutral family of the material on the page: cards, panels, wells, control fills, borders, floating layers. Generated against a page lifted by SURFACE_LIFT so a card separates from the page by lightness.
concepts.intent: Telling a card apart from the page without a border or shadow.
concepts.not: Not the page (ground) and not text (ink). Older usage called ground and ink together 'surface anchors'; that meaning is retired. Not a painted element of a component, which ui-materials calls a part.

concepts.definition: The neutral family of text and inverse fills: fg, fg-muted, fg-subtle, bg-inverse, the dark label.
concepts.intent: Text that reads on both ground and surface.

concepts.definition: A position on a family's ramp with a fixed job: 1–2 backgrounds (1 is the page), 3–5 interactive fills, 6–8 borders, 9–10 solids, 11–12 text. Placed per mode by APCA contrast against the page.
concepts.intent: Picking a color by what it does, so it works in every mode and every family.
concepts.not: Not a lightness: step 5 of yellow and step 5 of blue differ in lightness, and a step's value changes between modes. Not a base or tonal stop.

concepts.definition: A translucent twin of a step, solved per mode so that over ground 1 it equals its solid step.
concepts.intent: Fills that sit on more than one background.

concepts.definition: The color system's mode-independent layer: each family's tonal stops 050–950 on the HCT tone ladder.
concepts.intent: Brand, illustration and marketing colors that stay put across modes.
concepts.not: Not the 12-step ramps (they have jobs and modes) and not a source palette.

concepts.definition: Steps 9–12 of an accent: solid, hover and the two text steps, evenly spaced in page APCA Lc.
concepts.intent: Saturated keys over quiet steps 1–8.

concepts.definition: A family's filled-background step: 9 (or an anchored step), with hover one step on and active one step beyond it (or one step back where the label would fail).
concepts.intent: Buttons, badges and other filled marks that carry a label.

concepts.definition: The text color on a solid: the light label (white first, kept whenever it passes APCA Lc 45) or the dark label (for bright hues 70°–125°, or when white fails).
concepts.intent: Legible text on every solid without a per-color rule.

concepts.definition: A stop of the system's tonal layer, --palette-<family>-050…950: each family on a mode-independent HCT tone ladder.
concepts.intent: Marketing and illustration colors that stay put across modes; with tonalRoles, the stop nearest each role's solid.
concepts.not: Not a step (no job, no mode) and not a source palette's base stop, though the numbering matches.

concepts.definition: A semantic variable that names a family step (or a step at an alpha) for one job: bg, fg, primary-solid, border.
concepts.intent: Components paint with roles, so a theme or mode changes every component at once.
concepts.not: Not a family and not a color of its own.

concepts.definition: A role that maps a whole family: primary, secondary, neutral, critical, warning, success, info, each with -subtle, -subtle-hover, -border, -solid, -solid-hover, -solid-active, -on-solid, -fg and -1…12.
concepts.intent: Pointing a meaning at a family once.

concepts.definition: A role for the page itself rather than a family: bg, fg, border, surface, control fills, selection, backdrop, shadow, focus ring.
concepts.intent: The structure of a screen in neutral terms.

concepts.definition: The scale role for action: the first hue of the ring by default (indigo). Its solid is the one filled action per view.
concepts.intent: Making the main action and the current selection findable.
concepts.not: Not 'the brand color' as such; a brand pins it with an anchor.

concepts.definition: The scale role for a second brand hue (amber by default).
concepts.intent: A second identity color, used sparingly beside the primary.
concepts.not: Not a quieter primary: a component variant named secondary that fills with primary-subtle is a variant name, not this role.

concepts.definition: The scale roles with a fixed meaning: critical (red), warning (yellow), success (green), info (cyan).
concepts.intent: Meaning that survives any brand: a danger action is told apart by label, icon and placement, never by hue alone.

concepts.definition: Categorical data-1…N (CVD-searched), sequential data-seq-N and diverging data-div-N colors.
concepts.intent: Charts that stay distinguishable under color-vision deficiency.

concepts.definition: A role that is a step's color at a fixed alpha, written as oklch(L C H / a): bg-control*, shadow, bg-backdrop.
concepts.intent: Fills and casts that darken whatever is behind them by the same amount.
concepts.not: Not a live mix: the alpha is generated per mode, not computed by the browser.

concepts.definition: A role the request defines under `translucent`: a variable of the system, or a given color, at a fixed alpha per scheme, emitted as --colors-<name> in every mode.
concepts.intent: Giving a consumer a generated color at an alpha, without the system knowing what it is for.
concepts.not: Not a built-in role: the system defines no name or alpha for it, and the default system has none. Not an alpha step, which is solved to match a solid step.

concepts.definition: The veil behind dialogs and sheets: pure black at 80% in every mode.
concepts.intent: The dialog reads as the only layer.

concepts.definition: The request's strength for the selection fills, 0 quiet, 1 balanced, 2 loud. Resolved at generation: a whole number is an alias to a step, a value between is the generated OKLCH mix.
concepts.intent: One dial for how loud selection is.
concepts.not: Not a runtime variable; a different emphasis is a different generated system.

concepts.definition: An exact color pinned at a role's step (primary, secondary, neutral, status, ground, ink, surface); the family takes its hue and its neighbours ease toward it.
concepts.intent: Placing a brand's real colors in the system exactly.

concepts.definition: --colors-white and --colors-black: by default the two ends of the system, lighter and darker than every step and short of pure, keeping the neutral's hue; a named neutral step or pure #fff / #000 with the endpoints request key.
concepts.intent: A white and a black that belong to the palette.
concepts.not: Not the backdrop, which is always pure black. Not the lightest or darkest step of a ramp: a fill or text named white or black takes an endpoint, the same in every scheme.

concepts.definition: The polarity of a mode: light or dark (CSS color-scheme).
concepts.intent: What the platform and form controls need to know.
concepts.not: Not a mode: two modes (dark and dim) share the dark scheme.

concepts.definition: One generated variant of the system with its own scheme and settings: light, dark, light-contrast, dark-contrast, dim, or a custom extraMode.
concepts.intent: Every value a reader's preference (dark, more contrast, dimmer) needs, generated rather than inverted.
concepts.not: Not a theme: switching mode keeps the same inputs. Not ui-materials' material settings (lighting, transmission, delineation, chroma).

concepts.definition: A mode generated with APCA thresholds raised by 15 (light-contrast, dark-contrast), served under prefers-contrast: more.
concepts.intent: Readers who ask for more contrast.

concepts.definition: A named request: the full set of inputs (hues, neutrals, anchors, settings, emphasis) that produces one color system with all its modes.
concepts.intent: Different products or brands from one generator.
concepts.not: Not a mode (a theme has all the modes) and not a brand (a brand is the part of a theme that makes it someone's).

concepts.definition: The identity inputs of a theme: anchors, primary and secondary hues, neutral source.
concepts.intent: Making a generated system recognisably one company's.
concepts.not: Not a role; there is no --colors-brand.

concepts.definition: A named set of request defaults in system.mjs (`preset: "minimal"`); explicit keys win.
concepts.intent: A smaller output without listing every key.
concepts.not: Not a palette preset (presets.json).

concepts.definition: The color space a system targets: Display P3 by default, with sRGB values and a P3 upgrade under @media (color-gamut: p3); or sRGB only.
concepts.intent: Using a wide-gamut screen's range without breaking on others.

roles.$description: Every role variable the color system emits (without the --colors- prefix), with its concept. Scale roles are listed by suffix; `<scale>` is each of scaleRoles.
